President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Wednesday said the government is accelerating flood mitigation projects in Metro Manila, including drainage improvements, desilting operations, and pumping stations, as part of efforts to reduce chronic flooding in densely populated urban areas.

DENR, DUMEPENSA SA PAGPUPUTOL NG PUNO SA QUIRINO AVE.

Sinabi ng DENR-NCR ngayong Miyerkules na legal at may kaukulang permit ang pagputol ng mga puno sa Quirino Avenue sa Maynila para bigyang-daan ang konstruksyon ng Southern Access Link Expressway ng San Miguel Corp.

"The activity is covered by a duly issued permit (Permit No. 2026-02-24-TCEBP-1609) granted to the Southern Access Link Expressway Corporation," ayon sa DENR-NCR sa kanilang pahayag ngayong Mayo 20.

"To offset the trees that were cut, the project proponent is required to undertake large‑scale replacement planting within the next planting season as a condition of the permit," dagdag ng ahensya.

Sinabi ng DENR na pinapayagan sa ilalim ng umiiral na forestry at environmental laws ang pagputol o paglilipat ng mga puno para sa infrastructure projects basta’t may permit at sinusunod ang environmental safeguards. | via @francisorcio
